summary: ProText Mobility, Inc., an OTC Pink/OTCID-listed former SEC reporting company, voluntarily filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to place into the EDGAR record a September 28, 2026 GlobeNewswire press release providing an inter-quarter shareholder update. The release discusses ABSA's confirmation of an inaugural digital-asset custody pilot involving the Chairman, the Company's SVLT and real-world asset initiatives, international relationships, financial reporting program, and an intended regulated-exchange uplist strategy. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine corporate-update disclosure, not a special situation; watch for future uplist or asset-related filings.
